title: 1797. Player Power Management System
description:
Management System
50
Medium
Esports Tournament – Player Power Management System
Problem Statement
An Esports tournament tracks players and their power levels.
Each player has:
Player Name
Player ID
Current Power Level
You must design a class Player that manages power updates during the tournament.
Class Requirements
🔹 Private Data Members
string name
int id
int power
🔹 Public Member Functions
void input() → Read player details
void boost(int amount) → Increase power
void attack(int amount) → Decrease power (power cannot go below 0)
void display() → Print final player details
Input Format
First line contains an integer n — number of players.
For each player:
One line containing:
name id power
Next line containing two integers:
boostAmount attackAmount
Output Format
Print:
Final Player Stats:
Then print details of each player in the format:
Name: <name>, ID: <id>, Power: <power>
